terms.definition: The energy transferred by a force that moves an object.
terms.function: Its pushes translate into joule additions on the cart's energy.
terms.whyItMatters: It's the standard meter for energy flowing into machines, legs, and carts.

terms.definition: The formula that multiplies the pushing force by the distance moved.
terms.whyItMatters: It quantifies every horizontal push, lift, and machine transfer in joules.
terms.whereItIs: The counter as the marks fill up.

terms.definition: If the object never moves, no energy transfers and the work is zero.
terms.whyItMatters: It separates real pushes from tiring holds — the 'no move, no work' rule.
terms.whereItIs: The track edge with the cart parked.

terms.definition: The SI unit of work and energy.
terms.whyItMatters: Work, kinetic energy, and heat all get counted on this node.
